steps: Take office as US in Hormuz Convoy
Played 12 months with Approve and Execute
scenarios.notes: Looks crafted, not an AI dashboard, with several layout defects at 1024x768.

steps: Picked a crisis response card on the desk
Switched to Map, tapped Mexico, opened order menu
scenarios.notes: Order cards look the same on both surfaces; the map bottom strip is broken at tablet width. My Add tap on the map did not register on first try and the order was not queued.

friction.expected: Tagline and mode text clear of the globe
friction.happened: Pick a fire headline, description and Today card sit on top of map labels and pins (Russia, Iran); Play this seed box overlaps Africa

friction.expected: Coach mark points at the thing it describes
friction.happened: Step 1 tooltip covers the crisis headline; step 2 covers card 3 and its arrow points at nothing

friction.expected: Three equal cards, free badge visible
friction.happened: Card 3 sits lower than 1 and 2 and its Cabinet pick tag hides the free badge; YOUR PICK stamp covers the Hurts banner text

friction.where: Desk right rail, This month you will
friction.happened: Names truncated (Reply via Mu..., National addr...) and the list is clipped behind the Approve button
Added/Remove text from a staff card renders on top of the Approve button; overlapping text
Political capital on desk and HUD, diamond 1 left on map strip and menus; Orders vs order slot

friction.expected: Colour means good or bad consistently
friction.happened: UAE view of you 75 to 71 shows green bar and green number next to a red chip; the buttons sit below the fold at 768px and need a scroll

friction.expected: Picture matches headline; month matches header
friction.happened: North Korea missiles headline shows the US situation room; masthead says month 1 of 12 while HUD says month 2
Mexico won't sign a defence treaty in the middle of a war, though Mexico is not at war
MISSION FAILED stamp, grade D, 0 stars, yet title Master Diplomat and achievement Strait Open, Bomb Never; score counter starts at 0 and grade is blank for a few seconds
Chart says start 50, briefing said 44; x axis ends at O after 11 labels
IRGC, Muscat, midterms, defence pacts, Mojtaba Khamenei appear without in-place explanation (IRGC and Muscat tooltips absent)

bugs.title: Add to this month on map menu not registering first time
steps: Click Court Mexico Add to this month
bugs.actual: Driver reported failure and Court Mexico was not in the debrief

bugs.title: Result card actions below fold on tablet
Approval start mismatch
steps: Finish game, open How you were seen

suggestions.what: Fix tablet layout: map bottom strip, rail truncation, card alignment, result card fold
Make coach marks point at their target and not cover content

delight: Wide serif headlines, grain and lit-room scene art on the desk and newspaper: real art direction (devloop/instances/world-conflict/runs/iter-01/shots/sam-tablet/011-paper.png)
YOUR PICK stamp when choosing a card (devloop/instances/world-conflict/runs/iter-01/shots/sam-tablet/005-card.png)

fun.reason: Choices read well and results show cause and effect, but I auto-approved most months.

clarity.reason: Mission bar and Hurts tags are clear; jargon and duplicated vocabulary hurt.

visual.reason: Real art direction and typography; layout collisions at tablet size cost points.

feels_like_a_game.reason: Stamps, scenes, newspaper and reveal feel authored, not a dashboard.

agency.reason: Never fully blocked, but a failed Add tap and disabled options with odd reasons.

realism.reason: Mexico war reason, news art mismatch and approval start mismatch break trust.

replay.reason: Eight flashpoints and a daily seed invite another go.

recommend.reason: I would show it to friends with caveats about polish at smaller sizes.

verbatim: It is not a dashboard, someone cared about the art. But the overlaps on my tablet and two names for the same currency are the kind of thing I would fix before telling anyone.
